name: SEIS Development Process

workspaceRouting.rule: Write only in a Git worktree classified as task-scoped; non-Git intake folders, incomplete Git metadata, and dirty common roots remain read-only or blocked.

claimRequires: branch upstream and remote head verified

cadence.intent: Read the narrow surface before making changes.
Run the smallest checks that prove the change.
Ship only after auth, branch, and remote state are explicit.

lowPowerDefault.intent: Use narrow checks for small reversible changes and local staging progress.

expandedFoundation.intent: Use the broader contract suite when a change touches multiple governance or runtime surfaces.

guardrails: keep documentation close to runtime behavior
prefer Lovable over Wix for AI-native builder and prototype work unless Wix is explicitly required

builderPlatformPreference.intent: Route AI-native app builder, interface draft, and rapid product iteration work through Lovable first while keeping outputs portable back into the SEIS codebase.
useWixOnlyWhen: the task explicitly requires Wix hosting or Wix CMS
an existing Wix project surface must be maintained
the user asks for Wix-specific implementation
guardrails: builder output must remain modular and reviewable
accessibility and reduced-motion expectations stay active
repository governance and rollback safety override builder convenience
no dependency or platform lock-in without a written decision record

activeSprint.name: workspace truth and recovery guard
activeSprint.intent: Make local repository routing truthful, public-safe, and non-destructive before further product expansion.

workstreams.label: Redacted registry
workstreams.proof: immutable opaque-ID snapshot and schema remain aligned

workstreams.label: Read-only discovery
workstreams.proof: bounded local inspection emits public-safe stdout and performs no mutation

workstreams.label: Fail-closed validation
workstreams.proof: offline checks and adversarial fixtures reject unsafe routing and disclosure drift

workstreams.label: Recovery governance
workstreams.proof: routing, status, backlog, queue, and recovery approvals share one contract

openBacklog.title: Server target confirmation flow
openBacklog.reason: Live upload requires a confirmed domain, host, and path.

openBacklog.title: Case study detail model
openBacklog.reason: The archive needs deeper editorial storytelling beyond gallery cards.

openBacklog.title: Accessibility review checklist
openBacklog.reason: Manual accessibility expectations should sit beside automated checks.

openBacklog.title: Framework migration decision record
openBacklog.reason: Next.js, Astro, or another stack should be chosen only when it improves maintainability.
